versions.built_for: Modding API 0.1 as documented on mod-api and implemented in PR #2434 (feat/game-rs, WIP; rebased on the Rust builder as of 2026-11-28)
versions.fallback: one artifact family (a Longshot mod folder) serves every Longshot release whose Modding API is 0.1: the mod probes has('capture.frame')/has('game.pause')/hideGameHud and degrades per subsystem; the feature floor is photo mode (free camera) with capture logged as a plan until the capture seam lands (see seams.md). NOTE: no public release carries API 0.1 yet (verified 2026-11-28): stable v3.2.0's binary has no Modding API; nightly-895's Rust builder answers `Longshot.exe mod import` but stubs the code-mod tools (check/test/run exit 125 until the Mod API's crate fills the dispatch). This mod loads only where API 0.1 ships. A mod written for API 0.2 would need its own api pin.
